d: Watch the match highlights and all goals from Panama vs England in Group L of the FIFA World Cup 2026 at MetLife Stadium in East Rutherford, New Jersey. After a scoreless first half in the rain, Jude Bellingham opened the scoring in the 62nd minute off Bukayo Saka's corner before setting up Harry Kane five minutes later for a record-breaking header that sealed a 2-0 win and top spot in Group L ahead of the Round of 32.
